description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeEducationAPI class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete), validation rules, and service interactions related to employee education data within the HR system.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeEducationAPI endpoints and logic in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads initial test fixtures for employee education data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEducationService
methods.description: Verifies that the API correctly returns an EmployeeEducationService instance.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee education record by ID, ensuring correct data normalization and meta information.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks validation rules for the retrieval of a single employee education record.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Verifies updating an employee education record, including saving and data normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for updating an employee education record.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of an employee education record and handling of record not found exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for deleting employee education records.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new employee education record, including data persistence and normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for creating new employee education records.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all employee education records for an employee, ensuring correct data and metadata.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for retrieving multiple employee education records.
